column1: # ApplyLabelSpec.java spec for /C132E0278.fullbin (2026-11-03): globals of interrupt_timer_2000hz().
# Tick rates (0278): every ISR = 2 kHz (0.5 ms); 1 kHz slot reload 2; 200 Hz slot reload 10;
# 100/50/20/10 Hz nested in 200 Hz; 5 Hz/333 ms/2 Hz/1 Hz nested in 10 Hz. Timer units below follow
# the block each variable is counted in. TCR1 timestamps = 0.1 us, 24-bit wrap.
